description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Marcus
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Tantalus Blade (0~2), removed after using Tantalus Blade two times

description.text: Keeps track of Tantalus Blade level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Marcus]
